svg.title: The life of one private buy
svg.desc: Six steps from deposit to the way back: deposit about 40 seconds, get ready in the background with an 8.3 second proof, a fresh wallet in up to 39 seconds ahead of time, the tap at p50 1.2 seconds and p95 3.3 seconds on a phone, exits signed right after the fill, and back to the vault.
svg.text: From deposit to the way back
Any wallet, any chain, into the vault.
Commitment proof: 0.6 s on an iPhone.
8.3 s on an iPhone, in the background
A withdraw proof, made while you browse,
up to 39 s, ahead of time
NEAR Intents funds a new wallet on
Phone, Solana, tap to filled, 5 live buys.
Signed on the device, sent on several paths.
Stop and take-profit share one nonce,
A sell returns to the vault as a new note.
Withdraw to any address, any time.
A proof check on NEAR: 33.6 Tgas, about 0.003 NEAR
